amp1.name: Real Number System
amp1.description: This topic covers defining number sets, identifying characteristics, understanding relations between sets, using radical notation, evaluating and approximating roots, and placing numbers on a number line.

skills.name: Define and identify various sets of the real number system (natural, whole, integers, rational, irrational, real)
Use radical notation to express roots and evaluate perfect squares and cubes
Approximate square and cube roots using a calculator
Place real numbers on the real number line
Identify irrational numbers
Apply real number properties such as the distributive property

amp1.name: Whole Numbers and Integers
amp1.description: This topic focuses on performing operations with whole numbers and integers, factorization, exponents, finding GCF and LCM, and applying the order of operations.

skills.name: Perform operations with whole numbers and integers
Find factors, prime factorization, greatest common factor (GCF), and lowest common multiple (LCM)
Use exponents on whole numbers
Apply order of operations to perform calculations on integers
Evaluate numerical expressions using absolute value

amp1.name: Fractions
amp1.description: This topic covers operations on fractions and mixed numbers, defining types of fractions, conversions, simplification, reciprocals, and complex fractions.

skills.name: Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division on proper, improper, and mixed fractions
Convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions
Simplify fractions and define reciprocals
Perform operations on complex fractions
Identify the largest and smallest numbers in a set of fractions

amp1.name: Decimals
amp1.description: This topic involves converting decimals to fractions and percents, identifying base units of measure, performing metric conversions, evaluating algebraic expressions, using scientific notation, and rounding decimals.

skills.name: Convert decimals to fractions and percents
Identify base units of measure and perform metric conversions
Evaluate algebraic expressions involving decimals
Write numbers in scientific notation and standard notation
Round numbers to specified decimal places

amp1.name: Percent
amp1.description: This topic covers defining percent, converting between percent, fraction, and decimal forms, solving various percent problems, calculating percent increase and decrease, and determining weighted averages.

skills.name: Define percent and convert between percent, fraction, and decimal forms
Solve percent problems, such as finding a percentage of a number or determining what percent one number is of another
Calculate percent increase and percent decrease
Calculate unweighted and weighted averages

amp1.name: Solving Equations
amp1.description: This topic focuses on solving linear equations using various properties, including those with brackets and fractions, and solving proportions for unknown values.

skills.name: Determine whether a given number is a solution for an equation
Solve linear equations using the addition and division properties
Solve equations that contain brackets and fractions
Solve a proportion for an unknown value

amp1.name: Formula Rearrangement
amp1.description: This topic involves solving equations or formulas for a specific variable, including those with linear, quadratic, and fractional forms.

skills.name: Rearrange linear formulas to solve for a specific variable
Rearrange formulas involving squares and square roots
Rearrange formulas with multiple occurrences of the target variable
Rearrange formulas containing fractions

amp1.name: Laws of Exponents
amp1.description: This topic covers performing calculations and simplifying expressions involving zero and positive exponents using the fundamental laws of exponents.

skills.name: Evaluate expressions with zero and positive exponents
Simplify expressions using the product, quotient, and power rules of exponents
Express numbers in scientific notation

amp1.name: Negative Exponents
amp1.description: This topic focuses on performing calculations and simplifying expressions that involve negative exponents.

skills.name: Simplify expressions containing negative exponents
Perform calculations involving negative exponents
Apply the laws of exponents with negative powers

amp1.name: Polynomials
amp1.description: This topic covers defining polynomials, identifying their types, determining their degree, writing them in descending order, and performing basic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, including squaring binomials.

skills.name: Define polynomials and identify monomials, binomials, and trinomials
Determine the degree of a polynomial with one variable
Write polynomials in descending exponent form
Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of polynomials
Square a binomial

amp1.name: Factoring
amp1.description: This topic focuses on finding the greatest common factor, factoring various types of trinomials, factoring differences of squares, factoring by grouping, and factoring sums and differences of cubes.

skills.name: Find the greatest common factor from a polynomial
Factor trinomials of the form x^2+bx+c and ax^2+bx+c
Factor a difference of squares
Factor by grouping
Factor a sum and a difference of cubes

amp1.name: Rational Expressions
amp1.description: This topic covers determining values for which rational expressions are defined, simplifying them, and performing operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, as well as finding the lowest common denominator.

skills.name: Determine the values for which a rational algebraic expression is defined
Simplify rational algebraic expressions
Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of rational algebraic expressions
Find the lowest common denominator of rational algebraic expressions

amp1.name: Geometry
amp1.description: This topic includes understanding significant digits, classifying angles and triangles, applying angle-sum principles and the Pythagorean Theorem, calculating areas and perimeters of 2D shapes, and determining volumes and surface areas of 3D shapes, as well as working with similar triangles.

skills.name: Determine the number of significant digits of an approximate number
Classify angles (right, acute, obtuse, straight) and triangles (scalene, equilateral, right, isosceles)
Use the angle-sum principle and the Pythagorean Theorem
Find the area and perimeter of squares, rectangles, triangles, and circles
Find the volume and surface area of spheres, cones, cylinders, and prisms
Recognize similar triangles and identify corresponding parts to find missing measures

amp1.name: Equation of the Line
amp1.description: This topic covers calculating distance and midpoint, determining slopes of lines (including parallel and perpendicular), graphing lines from various information, writing linear equations, and understanding horizontal and vertical lines.

skills.name: Determine distance and midpoint between two points
Determine the slope of a line, including parallel and perpendicular lines
Graph a line given its slope, intercepts, or two points
Write the equation of a line from standard form to slope-intercept form and vice versa
Graph horizontal and vertical lines from their equations
Find the equation of a line given various conditions (slope, point, parallel or perpendicular line)

amp1.name: Systems of Equations and Inequalities
amp1.description: This topic focuses on determining the number of solutions for systems of equations, solving systems of linear equations using graphing, elimination, or substitution methods, and graphing linear inequalities on a number line or x-y plane.

skills.name: Determine the number of solutions for a system of equations
Solve a system of linear equations in two variables using graphing, elimination, or substitution methods
Graph linear inequalities on a number line or x-y plane
Solve a system of linear inequalities in two variables by graphing

amp1.name: Trigonometry
amp1.description: This topic covers defining primary and secondary trigonometric ratios, using a calculator to find numerical values and angles, calculating unknown side lengths and acute angles in right triangles, and converting between degrees, minutes, and seconds.

skills.name: Define primary trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent)
Define secondary trigonometric ratios (cosecant, secant, cotangent)
Use a calculator to determine numerical values of trigonometric ratios for angles between 0 and 90 degrees
Use trigonometric ratios to calculate unknown side lengths in right triangles
Use a calculator to determine the size of an angle from its trigonometric value
Convert between degrees, minutes, and seconds

amp1.name: Data Management
amp1.description: This topic involves interpreting data presented in various graphical forms such as circle graphs, histograms, bar charts, tables, scatterplots, and line graphs.

skills.name: Interpret data from line graphs to understand trends and rates of change
Interpret data from scatterplots to identify relationships
Interpret data from bar charts and tables to extract specific information
Analyze and compare data presented in different formats
Calculate averages and differences from data sets

amp1.name: Functions
amp1.description: This topic covers defining relations, representing them in various forms, determining domain and range, identifying functions, evaluating functions, describing and sketching graphs of transformations, and converting quadratic forms.

skills.name: Define relations and represent them as ordered pairs, tables, graphs, or equations
Determine the domain and range of a relation
Determine if a particular relation is a function
Evaluate a function at a given value in its domain
Identify the axis of symmetry and vertex of quadratic functions
Convert quadratic equations between standard and vertex forms

amp1.name: Logarithms
amp1.description: This topic involves changing expressions between exponential and logarithmic forms, using laws of logarithms to rewrite expressions and solve equations, and finding common logarithms and antilogarithms using a calculator.

skills.name: Convert expressions between exponential and logarithmic forms and vice versa
Use the laws of logarithms to rewrite expressions
Solve literal equations involving logarithms
Use a calculator to find common logarithms and antilogarithms
Solve logarithmic equations

amp1.name: Word Problems
amp1.description: This topic applies skills from all other topics (1-19) to solve problems presented as English simple-sentence descriptions, with or without diagrams.

skills.name: Translate word problems into mathematical equations or expressions
Apply problem-solving strategies from algebra, geometry, and other math topics
Solve problems involving quadratic functions, such as finding maximum values
Solve systems of equations derived from word problems
Solve geometry-related word problems, including those involving similar triangles and volume

amp2.name: Quadratic Functions
amp2.description: Quadratic formula, vertex, discriminant, and graphs.

amp2.name: Polynomial Functions
amp2.description: Roots, end behavior, and graphs of polynomials.

amp2.name: Exponential Functions
amp2.description: Growth, decay, and solving exponential equations.

amp2.name: Logarithmic Functions
amp2.description: Properties of logarithms and logarithmic equations.

amp2.name: Analytic Trigonometry and Identities
amp2.description: Fundamental, sum, difference, and double angle identities.

amp2.name: Graphs of Trigonometric Functions
amp2.description: Amplitude, period, phase shift, and transformations.

amp2.name: Sequences and Series
amp2.description: Arithmetic and geometric sequences, sigma notation, series.

amp2.name: Systems and Matrices
amp2.description: Matrix operations and solving systems with matrices.
